name: SummerStage
description_short: A theatre day camp at Arc Stages in Pleasantville for students entering kindergarten through grade 12. Campers take classes such as acting, Broadway dance, improv and stage combat, then rehearse a show they perform for families at the end of each three or four week session.
refund_policy_summary: Cancel before April 1 for a 75% refund, before May 1 for 50%, before June 1 for 25%; no refunds after June 1.

sessions.name: Little Theatre Session I (K to 1, 9 to 1)
Little Theatre Session II (K to 1, 9 to 1)
Teen Apprentice Program Session I (grades 9 to 12)

notes: Monday to Friday, 9 to 4 (Little Theatre 9 to 1, with the option to stay until 4 at the full day price). Young Actors, Tweens and Teens give two performances at the end of each session, one on a weekday evening and one on Saturday.
